d:
Daya mistakenly thinks Tapu won a medal at school and excitedly calls Jethalal at his shop. Overjoyed and proud, Jethalal buys his favorite sweets, closes early, and rushes home to celebrate with Bapuji—only to discover that Tapu simply found the medal lying on the street on his walk home.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
